title: Motor Overload
shortDescription: Motor drew too much current and shut off.
fullDescription: Blendtec detected an overcurrent condition. The motor stops to prevent damage. Often caused by overly thick mixtures or jar overload.

fixSteps.title: Add liquid
fixSteps.instruction: Add more liquid and reduce load below max line.

whenToCallPro: If error persists with empty jar.

title: Motor Overheat
fullDescription: Thermal sensor detected motor overheating. Unit must cool before reuse. Common after multiple consecutive heavy blends.

title: Jar Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Jar not detected or improperly seated.
fullDescription: Base does not detect a properly seated jar. Magnet or sensor issue.

fixSteps.title: Reseat jar
fixSteps.instruction: Lift and place jar firmly on base.

fixSteps.title: Test other jar
fixSteps.instruction: Try a known-good jar to isolate issue.

whenToCallPro: If both jars fail to register.

title: Coupler Slip
fullDescription: The drive coupling between base and jar blade is worn or slipping. Common wear part.

fixSteps.title: Inspect coupler
fixSteps.instruction: Check base and jar coupler for wear.

title: Control Board Fault
fullDescription: Control board self-test failed. May require service.

title: Tachometer Sensor
fullDescription: Tachometer cannot detect motor RPM. Likely sensor or wiring issue.
symptoms: Motor spins but no speed regulation

title: Blade Jam
fullDescription: Foreign object or frozen mass stopped blade rotation.

fixSteps.title: Stop and clear
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug, remove jar, manually free blade with spatula.

title: No Display Power
fullDescription: No lights or display when plugged in. Power supply or fuse issue.

fixSteps.title: Test outlet
fixSteps.instruction: Plug into different outlet, reset GFCI.

title: Touch Slider Unresponsive
fullDescription: Capacitive slider on Designer series not responding to touch. Often moisture-related.

title: WildSide Jar Leaking
fullDescription: WildSide+ jar leaking around the blade assembly. Seal worn or jar cracked.

fixSteps.title: Replace jar
fixSteps.instruction: Blade is non-removable; replace whole jar.

title: CL5 touch
fullDescription: CL5 touchpad fault. Common indication on Blendtec blender.

fixSteps.title: Test cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Run a normal cycle to verify.

whenToCallPro: If reset and cleaning don't fix, contact warranty service.

faq.a: Most issues are sensor/contact related — cleaning often fixes.
